records.title: HLS-Seek: QoR-Aware Code Generation for High-Level Synthesis via Proxy Comparative Reward Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The linked FlightLLM concerns FPGA execution of LLMs, while this paper optimizes the synthesis-code generation task; no inference-system connection is shown.

records.title: DORA: Dataflow-Instruction Orchestration Architecture for DNN Acceleration
records.reason: Hardware acceleration is relevant to FlightLLM/FPGA inference, but this general accelerator paper does not make an explicit LLM inference case; retain for a targeted workload check.

records.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity
records.reason: Concrete inference acceleration, but target is video diffusion rather than LLM/VLM inference; retain only as an adjacent visual-generation accelerator pending scope review.

records.title: Self-Consistent Latent Reasoning: Long Latent Sequence Reasoning for Vision-Language Model
records.reason: Connected to the recurrent latent-reasoning seed, but no demonstrated efficiency benefit or actionable inference optimization is reported.

records.title: Hint Tuning: Less Data Makes Better Reasoners
records.reason: Related to efficient-reasoning literature but the claimed efficiency is training data use, not the assigned inference-efficiency scope; keep borderline pending lineage-specific relevance review.
